shared_elements: horizontal band/register of repeated small motifs across the upper zone
profile figures with heads turned sideways
a smaller subsidiary figure beside a larger one
base band of repeating signs at the bottom of the scene
justification: Both are shallow relief surfaces organised into horizontal registers, with a band of repeated small motifs running along the top above a zone of profile figures, and a smaller secondary figure flanking a dominant one. The manner of execution is quite different, however: A is a coarse, sparse, animal-dominated carving on a free-standing weathered block, while B is a dense, finely modelled and painted wall panel filled edge-to-edge with rows of small signs and radiating lines from a central disc.
